name: Diligent Engine
listed_description: A modern cross-platform low-level 3D graphics library
reason: No numeric comparison found. DiligentEngine README and DiligentCore doc/PerformanceGuide.md contain no speed figures. DiligentSamples Samples/Asteroids README (raw.githubusercontent.com) describes a 50,000-asteroid benchmark that switches between native D3D11, native D3D12, Diligent D3D11, Diligent D3D12 and Diligent Vulkan modes, but publishes no fps or timing results. The project is an abstraction layer and does not claim to beat native APIs. WebSearch found only Intel's original Asteroids D3D12-vs-D3D11 numbers (19 fps to 33 fps), which are not Diligent results. Lead: a run of the Asteroids sample would give native versus Diligent overhead numbers.

name: DirectXTK
listed_description: A collection of helper classes for writing DirectX 11.x code in C++
reason: No numeric comparison found. README and wiki pages checked (Home, SpriteBatch, DDSTextureLoader, Mixing SimpleMath and DirectXMath) have only qualitative statements (for example more efficient to use XMVECTORF32, DX12 lower CPU overhead than DX11) with no measurements. Category guess color-and-resampling was wrong: it is a DirectX helper toolkit, not a resampling library.

name: dr_libs
listed_description: Single file audio decoding libraries for C and C++.
reason: No published numbers. README and dr_flac.h, dr_mp3.h and dr_wav.h headers make no speed claims. tests/flac/flac_decoding.c contains a profiling mode that prints libFLAC decode time, dr_flac decode time and a percentage, but no results are published anywhere reachable. dr_mp3 is a port of minimp3 (a separate project); dr_wav tests use libsndfile for correctness only. Two WebSearch queries found no third-party dr_flac versus libFLAC or dr_mp3 versus mpg123 benchmark. Lead: running tests/flac/flac_decoding.c profiling would produce dr_flac versus libFLAC numbers.

name: DynaPDF
reason: No evidence reachable. Commercial closed-source library (non-OSI, no public repo). Vendor site www.dynaforms.com failed with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND. One WebSearch for DynaPDF benchmarks returned only a feature comparison page (MBS Plugins, DynaPDF vs PDFKit and WinPDF, no speed numbers) and a Xojo forum complaint about slowdowns; no numeric comparison with poppler or PDFium.

name: FMOD
listed_description: An easy to use crossplatform audio engine and audio content creation tool for games.
reason: No evidence reachable. Proprietary engine (free for non-commercial, no public source repo). www.fmod.com failed with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND. One WebSearch for FMOD versus Wwise CPU benchmarks found only Audiokinetic (Wwise vendor) guidance with no FMOD measurements and no head-to-head numbers.

name: Fontconfig
reason: No numeric comparison against another named baseline. gitlab.freedesktop.org is blocked by the egress proxy (CONNECT 403). The GitHub mirror https://github.com/fontconfig/fontconfig NEWS (2.18.3) has entries such as 'Speed up FcConfigCompareValue' and 'Improve performance in FcConfigAdd' without figures. WebSearch snippets only: fontconfig MR 112 (FcFontSort from 80-100 ms to 6-8 ms per call with many Noto families) and a Theseus thesis by Michal Srb (up to 98% speedups); both compare Fontconfig with its own earlier code and neither page could be opened (MR host blocked, www.theseus.fi ENOTFOUND). Lead: MR 112 and the Srb thesis if the host becomes reachable.
